title: Scoped authorization fanout for console usage views
creator: Sana Patel
description: Build a scoped authorization fanout layer for Console analytics/usage endpoints that enforces row- and column-level permissions across multi-tenant views. This ticket implements the backend enforcement surface (query proxy middleware + entitlements cache + audit logging) and defines a safe rollout path so usage dashboards only return rows/columns a principal is allowed to see without increasing tail latency beyond SLA. Key concerns: correctness for edge cases (role changes during query), cache invalidation, permission-driven query planning impact on batching, and compatibility with Dedicated/Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: All Console analytics endpoints return filtered results matching the configured tenant/role entitlements for the requesting principal
Permission checks are performed server-side in the analytics query proxy and cannot be bypassed by the UI
Permission cache TTL and invalidation hooks are implemented and tested; role change within 30s is reflected after invalidation in staging
Column-level masking honors 'masked' and 'redacted' flags in entitlement model and is validated by unit + integration tests
End-to-end latency increase for median requests is < 15ms and P95 increase < 50ms compared to baseline (measured in staging harness)
Audit log entries are emitted for denied requests and permission-granted query fragments with request_id and policy version
Feature is behind a feature-flag and can be enabled per-organization for canary rollout
tasks: Design entitlement schema extensions: add view_id, column_mask, time_window_scopes, delegation rules
Implement analytics-query-proxy middleware that translates JWT claims to entitlement checks and rewrites queries with safe predicates
Add permission cache service with namespacing by org and a fast invalidation path triggered by SSO/SCIM/console role changes
Create column-masking module that rewrites projected columns to COALESCE(mask(), NULL) patterns where appropriate
Instrument audit logging with structured fields: principal, org_id, view_id, query_hash, policy_version, decision
Write unit tests for middleware + cache behavior and integration tests using staging analytics dataset
Run performance benchmark harness and tune query planner to avoid unbounded fanout for large orgs
Draft migration/playbook for Dedicated/Private customers (migration flag + operator migration script)
Add console + API docs for the new entitlements and feature flag
Create rollout plan: internal beta, 3 customer canaries, full opt-in, then default-on after 4 weeks
comments: 2026-03-01 Sana Patel: Initial ticket created after PM spike confirmed inconsistent permission enforcement across usage routes. Goal: single enforcement layer that works for hosted + dedicated.
2026-03-03 Dmitri Ivanov: Spike results - rewriting queries in proxy added ~8ms median. For large JOINs, rewriting can cause planner to choose nested loop; need planner hints or push filters earlier.

2026-03-05 Priya Rao (Security): Please ensure audit format aligns with compliance logging spec (link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/audit-format). Also flag column-level masking for legal review.

2026-03-06 Dmitri Ivanov: Decided to use attribute-driven model: permissions = actor attributes + org entitlements. Avoid per-record policy eval in application layer; we will translate to SQL predicates where possible.

2026-03-07 Alex Chen (Infra): Cache design note - use Redis namespace per org with a version key. On role change bump version to invalidate cheaply. We'll expose an event endpoint for SCIM/SSO to call.
2026-03-09 QA: Found an edge case where a time-window scoped entitlement allowed queries for future windows when the user's timezone differed. Adding timezone-normalization step to entitlement check.
2026-03-11 Dmitri Ivanov: Security review requested and scheduled for 2026-03-15. Preparing test vectors and sample audit logs for the reviewers.
2026-03-12 Sana Patel: Updated acceptance criteria to include performance SLOs and feature-flag gating after benchmark results.
